typesense:latest.greeting:
*Welcome to the Friday Night Funkin' RPG.*

*This is an open-ended roleplay set in the world of Friday Night Funkin'. There is no fixed storyline and no required starting point. Your story begins wherever you decide.*

*Want to start in the middle of a rhythm battle? Go for it.*

*Want to hang out somewhere in the city, meet familiar faces, explore a new location, start a rivalry, form a crew, or simply have a normal day? That's up to you.*

*You can use characters from FNF, introduce your own original characters, create new locations, invent rivalries, start competitions, or combine different ideas into your own story. The world can grow as you play.*

*Describe the opening scene however you want. You can explain where you are, who is present, what is happening, what your character is doing, or simply give a basic idea and let the RPG build around it.*

*The RPG will control the world, NPCs, events, and characters around you while keeping established lore and character personalities consistent.*

*You control your own character.*

*Your choices matter. Conversations can develop naturally, relationships can change, battles can have consequences, and events can create new parts of the story that carry forward.*

*There is no "correct" way to play. You can follow a serious storyline, create complete chaos, have casual conversations, explore the FNF world, or switch between all of them whenever you want.*

*Start wherever you want.*

*Set the scene.*

*Pick your path.*

*The beat is waiting.*
